## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slender girl with an oval, freckled face, a pretty nose, and big, luminous gray eyes. Her once-red hair is clustering, silky, and turned to an auburn shade, which she wears in heavy braids or stylish curls. Her complexions and expressions continuously shift into rosy, luminous, and starry beauty as her emotions change.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P13](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0013), [v1 c28 P6](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0006), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c36 P32](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0032), [v1 c37 P32](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0032), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c9 P6](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0006), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v2 c25 P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P41](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0041), [v3 c9 P1](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0001), [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035)_

## Personality

Anne is highly imaginative, romantic, and ambitious, possessing a deep love for beauty and nature. She is passionate and impulsive, often plunging high into enthusiasm before crashing into despair or making hasty choices without thinking. She is intensely loyal and affectionate toward her true friends, holding high ideals while keeping a pure, transparent, and unselfish nature. Strongly opposed to harsh punishments and unfairness, she displays a real knack for nurturing children and winning over those around her.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P0](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0000), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v2 c2 P10](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0010), [v2 c3 P16](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0016), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c13 P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v2 c28 P24](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0024)_

- To win the Thorburn Scholarship in English to cover her college expenses  <sub>[v3 c9 P0](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0000)</sub>
- To bring beauty, joy, and community improvement to Avonlea  <sub>[v2 c1 P55](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0055)</sub>

## History

After being orphaned in Bolingbroke, Anne spent a hard early childhood working for foster families and living in an asylum before being adopted by Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert at Green Gables. She quickly made Avonlea her beloved home, excelling at school and competing passionately in academic rivalries with Gilbert Blythe. After completing a year at Queen's Academy and winning the Avery Scholarship, she chose to stay in Avonlea as a teacher to support Marilla following Matthew's death. During her time teaching, she co-founded the Avonlea Village Improvement Society and served as its secretary. Upon completing her two years of teaching, she enrolled at Redmond College in Kingsport alongside close friends Priscilla Grant and Gilbert Blythe. At Redmond, Anne flourished socially and academically, eventually moving into Patty's Place with her chums, and dedicating herself to winning the Thorburn Scholarship in English.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c8 P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P32](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0032), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c11 P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c4 P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 c9 P0](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0000), [v3 c10 P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047)_

## Background by volume

- Born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, to high school teacher Walter Shirley and Bertha Shirley  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- Orphaned as an infant and raised through stinted foster homes and an asylum  <sub>[v1 c3 P43](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0043), [v1 c6 P9](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0009), [v1 c8 P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)</sub>
- Adopted by Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert of Green Gables in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c6 P9](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0009), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046)</sub>
- Attended Queen's Academy and earned a First Class teacher's license and the Avery Scholarship  <sub>[v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P32](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0032)</sub>
- Taught at Avonlea school for two years while helping Marilla raise the Keith twins  <sub>[v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c11 P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v3 c5 P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007)</sub>
